why: Next greater element, but the answer is a distance, so the stack holds indices: days still waiting for a warmer day. When a warmer day arrives it resolves every waiting colder day on top of the stack, and the answer is the difference of indices.
hints: Which earlier days does today's temperature answer?
Every still-waiting day that is colder than today. The waiting days have non-increasing temperatures from bottom to top, so the colder ones are all on top.
Scan left to right with a stack of indices: while temps[top] < temps[i], pop j and set answer[j] = i - j; then push i. Days left on the stack get 0. O(n).
pitfalls: Store indices, not temperatures, so you can compute the distance.
Strictly warmer: an equal temperature does not resolve a waiting day.
